known_limitations: Only one current NVIDIA GPU and one current integrated AMD GPU; Intel physical hardware not present or qualified.
AMD global memory is shared/system-backed, not dedicated VRAM.
This fixture exercises upload and readback APIs with independent byte parity, not a compute kernel, P2P or combined VRAM.

Upstream single-test mode returns zero after parse even for a test failure; acceptance additionally requires the TestResult::Success-only statistics line, exact selected device, two samples and clean stderr.
show_devices_ocl has no argument parser and ignores --help; that invocation enumerated devices instead.
CopyBuffer has no independent payload parity and was not executed.
No corruption option exists for ReadBufferMisaligned; failure discriminator was source-reviewed, not injected live.
Version metadata is unset from clean archive export; external recorded commit pins and archive SHA256 establish provenance.
Eight Linux Level Zero/Vulkan symlink entries were deliberately excluded from export because APIs are disabled; all remaining regular files/directories extracted under a verified destination.
No upstream source edits, installs, drivers, global PATH, or retained GPU jobs.

prebuild_errors.error: AssertionError on Linux symlink archive entry before extraction; adopted explicit logged skip of irrelevant Level Zero/Vulkan .so symlinks.
Python 3.10 TarFile.extractall does not support filter keyword; used individually verified path containment, rejected links/nonregular entries, and extracted only regular files/directories.
